newsitem.title: USA: Allied Group Q1 net climbs as premiums grow.
newsitem.headline: Allied Group Q1 net climbs as premiums grow.

text.p: Allied Group Inc said Tuesday a double-digit increase in property-casualty premiums contributed to higher net income in the first quarter ended March 31.
The insurance holding company posted net income of $15.9 million versus $13.9 million a year ago. Total revenues reached $158.7 million, up from $143.3 million in the same period in 1996.
Property-casualty premiums climbed 12 percent to $131.9 million from $118.9 million a year ago, Allied Group said.
The company's shares were up 1/8 Tuesday at 35-1/4.
